method: Normal public navigation in the user's Chrome, accessibility/DOM inspection, supported request/response inspection; no protection changes.
scope: Bounded representative workflows, not a full catalogue crawl or a native-provider release.
rights: No rights to import proprietary code or redistribute episode media established. Independently implemented behavior and factual observations are separate from payload reuse.
redaction: No cookies, credentials, third-party API keys, opaque resolver payloads, server_ids, media bodies or temporary media resource paths are included.

metadataChain.denominatorScope: US Netflix movie availability filter at observation; not Cinejoy's complete catalogue or native-playback coverage.
metadataChain.integrationRequirement: Use the project's own authorized TMDB credentials and observe TMDB terms; never reuse a source site's key.

sites.platformFilterRole: Catalogue availability metadata. These are not the player server menu and grant no access to a service's media.

player.deliveryObserved: native HTML video with blob source

resolver.requestShape: Opaque non-JSON body; protocol not decoded
resolver.transformLocation: A public client chunk initiates fetch; encoding/decoding contract remains unverified
resolver.limitations: Successful HTTP and permissive CORS do not establish API entitlement, a playable source or an independent adapter.

lastCheck.meaning: The earlier paused position remained after other server attempts. This does not verify those selections.

player.ownershipInference: Shared host families do not establish common backend or ownership. Preserve every visible label.

publicClientInspection.access: The already-observed module URL opened as public source text in Chrome after the earlier resource-content tool read failed.
observed: WebAssembly is loaded and called in request preparation
The input envelope contains path and payload
The prepared envelope has responseKey, keyId, ephemeralPublic and body fields
The ordinary flow POSTs the encoded body to /g and processes a binary response
publicClientInspection.handling: Read-only source inspection; no module, WebAssembly or key material imported or executed in Solanime. No external decryptor service used.

remaining: Determine provider-specific stable IDs and resource mapping through permitted ordinary flows
Verify request/response transformations without third-party decryptors or protection bypass
Establish supported independent integration and content-display permission
Test every enabled mapping on Solanime's deployed origin

featuresObserved: separate Movies, Shows and Anime navigation

identifierChain.namespaces: Movies/TV use numeric TMDB routes; anime uses a separate slug namespace. Do not assume interchangeable IDs.

episodeCoverage.meaning: One title only, not a full site denominator. Initial Loading and the rendered 500-record range must not become empty/exhausted inventory.

remaining: Capture the normal watch resolution request from its actual trigger
Diagnose failure before assigning a provider-wide state
Verify stable matching and supported independent delivery

sites.termsClaim: Client-side aggregation/personal use; no hosting; rights retained by owners. These are source claims, not independently established content rights.
sites.sourceRightsDisposition: No copying grant established; keep code/assets out of the product tree.
remaining: Diagnose the blank-page behavior without weakening browser protections
Inspect a title and normal playback chain

lastCheck.meaning: Normal navigation in the reconnected Chrome showed Cloudflare Performing security verification; the tab later returned to about:blank. No challenge was bypassed or protection setting changed.

remaining: Wait for ordinary authorized browser access; do not work around the verification challenge
Inspect title, episode and server workflows if access becomes available

implementationContract.catalogueFacets: Separate anime/movie/TV namespaces and provider-availability filters from playback sources. Do not display a working filter until imported rows power it.
implementationContract.artwork: Use verified banner dimensions for large placements and separate posters/logos; never fill a large hero with an enlarged thumbnail. Preserve explicit fallbacks and provenance.
implementationContract.episodes: Treat delayed loading distinctly from empty data; reconcile response totals and UI windows; preserve numbering and source IDs.
implementationContract.playback: Select stored episode-version mappings; resolve only on user intent; cancel old work and media; native and unsupported are separate results. HTTP success, binary responses and player menus do not prove playback.
implementationContract.restrictions: No source advertising, analytics, forced redirects, arbitrary URL proxy, captured temporary-source registry, API-key reuse or protection bypass.

separateFrom.reason: These are later dated observations, not a change to the pinned original research dump or an increase to its site count.
